text:
emma-people: Heads up team 1-Jun: small 'Thank You' popup during hiring open house. Purpose: thank interviewers and hand out spot recognition cards. Need volunteer runner, 2 people for card-writing station, and headcount for swag.

raj-recruiting: I'll bring interview schedules and can help with runner duties. How many interviewer volunteers expected?

liz-ops: Venue capacity note: lobby table plus one side table. We can host ~40 people comfortably.

sam-engineering: Happy to help write cards for interviewers at 11:30-12:15. Also can bring extra pens.

emma-people: Great. Volunteers so far: Raj (runner), Sam (cards). Need one more card station volunteer and someone to reorder swag (stickers and pens). Budget ~ $60.

lili-bot: Signup link: https://forms.redwood/thank-interviewers-jun1. Reminder set Fri 9am.

emma-people: Action items: Raj confirm runner duties by Thu EOD, Liz confirm table delivery by Fri noon, Sam + volunteer for cards, Emma to order stickers. I'll post final plan on #people-ops tomorrow.

raj-recruiting: Confirmed runner. I'll also grab extra name tags from supply closet.

liz-ops: Table delivered and taped. All good.

lili-bot: Calendar event created: https://calendar.redwood/events/thanks-hiring-popup.
